title: Composition of coefficient restriction squares for proper image
statement:
For any scheme morphism g:Z→W and any strict derived constant L-integral tower K, the two coefficient-restriction/proper-image squares for E→F→L paste to the direct E→L square under the canonical restriction compositors. No properness or finite-Tor hypothesis is needed.

Precise Lean statement with module variables:
```lean
variable (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
  (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
  (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra ℚ_[l] F] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] F]
  (i : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] F)
  (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
  (j : F →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L)
theorem properRestriction_composition {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ W)
    (K : Derived (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l L)) Z) :
    (U l E F i W).map ((properRestriction l F L j g).hom.app K) ≫
        (properRestriction l E F i g).hom.app ((U l F L j Z).obj K) ≫
        (R (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) g).map
          ((towerScalarRestrictionComposition l E F i L j Z).hom.app K) =
      (towerScalarRestrictionComposition l E F i L j W).hom.app
          ((R (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l L)) g).obj K) ≫
        (properRestriction l E L (j.comp i) g).hom.app K
```

proof.text: The ordinary cocycle holds on all sections. Both proper restriction maps are identity on the same base-change sections, and pbcRestrictComp is identity on sections. Extensionality gives equality of whole-tower morphisms.

Each properRestriction satisfies its defining whole-complex unit equation. normalized_comp pastes the first two normalized squares. The factorization formula for the exact restriction compositor and normalized_naturality compare that pasted square with the direct square. Evaluate the resulting natural-transformation equality at K.
